headline: Two o'clock. Wind keeps the cover.
body: Fifteen degrees under mostly cloudy skies, wind from the west near twenty-one with gusts past forty. Streets remain dry while the near lanes carry their mid-afternoon load. The sun sits high but soft behind the unbroken cover.
